# CVS Pharmacy

> > CVS Pharmacy is a leading retail pharmacy chain offering prescription services, ExtraCare rewards, MinuteClinic telehealth, photo printing, and comprehensive healthcare solutions through the CVS Health app.

CVS operates both physical retail locations and digital services across the United States, providing pharmacy services, vaccinations, COVID-19 and flu testing/treatment, medication delivery, and virtual care through MinuteClinic. The ExtraCare rewards program and ExtraBucks Rewards are central to customer engagement.

## Key Topics

- CVS Pharmacy
- ExtraCare rewards program
- ExtraBucks Rewards
- MinuteClinic virtual care
- CVS Health app
- Prescription refills and transfers
- Medication home delivery
- COVID-19 and flu testing
- Vaccine services
- Paxlovid treatment
- Online pharmacy management
- Same-day prescription pickup
- Senior care services
- Mobile app (iOS and Android)
- Telehealth services

## Pharmacy Services

- [CVS Pharmacy | Online Prescriptions, Transfers & Refills](https://www.cvs.com/pharmacy): Main pharmacy services hub for prescriptions, refills, and ExtraCare rewards
- [Prescriptions Online](https://www.cvs.com/content/prescriptions-online): Online prescription management via CVS Health app and web portal

## Healthcare & Testing

- [Flu and COVID-19 Testing & Treatment - CVS Pharmacy](https://www.cvs.com/content/covid-flu-test-and-treatment): COVID-19 and flu testing/treatment including Paxlovid at CVS locations
- [MinuteClinic Virtual Care](https://www.cvs.com/minuteclinic/virtual-care): 24/7 telehealth services via MinuteClinic for common illnesses and conditions

## Photo Services

- [Photo Prints - FREE Same Day Pickup at CVS Photo](https://www.cvs.com/photo/prints?cid=ps_ph): CVS Photo printing service with same-day pickup and multiple print sizes
